## Checklist

- [ ] It builds (`./gradlew assembleDebug`) and lint passes (`./gradlew lintDebug`)
- [ ] Tried on a real phone, not only the emulator
- [ ] New text is in `strings.xml`, with every language in `values-*/` filled in (or marked below as left in English)
- [ ] One change per pull request; nothing unrelated swept in
- [ ] No ads, trackers or analytics, and no keys, passwords or personal data in the code or commits
- [ ] For a new dependency: why it's needed, and that its licence works with GPLv3
